items.title:
io.github.wangpengxpy:gj-pf4j-security 1.0.1 发布, gj.spring.pf4j — Pluggable Authentication for Plugin Controllers.

  Two-layer provider API: AbstractPluginAuthenticationProvider (simple, single-strategy)
  and IPluginAuthenticationProvider (advanced, multi-provider routing with supports()).
  Strategy-driven provider chain: AtLeastOneSuccessfulStrategy (default) and
  FirstSuccessfulStrategy, both pluggable via AuthenticationStrategy bean override.

  Dual-stack auth filters: PluginDelegatingAuthFilter (MVC Servlet) and
  PluginDelegatingAuthWebFilter (WebFlux Reactive). Shared provider chain execution
  engine (AuthChainExecutor) for consistent behavior across both stacks.

  Seven-position filter extension framework: FIRST, SESSION_RESTORE, FORM_LOGIN,
  AUTHENTICATION (framework-reserved), ANONYMOUS, PRE_AUTHORIZE, LAST — each with
  Servlet and WebFlux interfaces, registered via lifecycle PluginResourceRegistrar.
  Three-tier host configuration: global on/off, per-position allowlist, per-plugin
  authorization — all disabled by default.

  Control-flow exceptions: PluginAuthChallenge (OAuth2/SAML redirect, non-error),
  PluginBadCredentialsException (client fault), PluginAuthServiceException (server
  fault). Authentication events (PluginAuthenticationSuccessEvent / FailureEvent)
  for host audit and alerting integration.

com.weavric:weavric-connectors 2.1.0 发布, Connectors SDK core for Weavric (#147). A connector is a manifest
        (ConnectorDefinition) of named operations — each itself a reusable WeaveDefinition — plus a
        shared set of private helper definitions and a connection setup spec. Operations are installed as
        dotted user-defined actions (connector.op) and dispatched through the existing userDefinedAction
        seam; connector-local helpers resolve LOCAL-FIRST via each operation's definitions map. Connections
        are tenant-scoped and reference secrets by name (never storing plaintext); a ConnectionMapView
        exposes the active connection to templates as {{ connection['...'] }} with secrets auto-redacted.

com.weavric:weavric-connectors-api 2.1.0 发布, Connector packaging/install API for Weavric (#148). Parses a connector
        manifest (YAML or JSON) into a ConnectorDefinition, runs a compatibility check
        (requires.engine / requires.modules) and installs it through the connectors SDK's
        ConnectorInstaller, exposing thin admin endpoints under /admin/connectors. As a LIBRARY this
        module does NOT impose a SecurityFilterChain; instead it provides a ConnectorAdminRequestMatcher
        that the consuming app wires into its own chain and MUST guard with an admin authority.
        Connector installs are app-wide (operations register into the global definition source);
        per-tenant connector registration is deferred to the scope phase.

com.weavric:weavric-secrets 2.1.0 发布, Per-tenant encrypted secrets vault for Weavric. Exposes secrets to templates
        as {{ secrets['name'] }} (mirroring the env[...] accessor) behind a pluggable ISecretStore SPI.
        Ships a default AES-GCM envelope-encrypted JDBC store activated only when JPA is on the classpath;
        consumers can plug Vault/AWS/etc. Secret values are auto-scrubbed (render as ***) anywhere they are
        serialized or logged; the real value is only obtainable via an explicit reveal().
